name: hcapp_updatePhotoCaption
description: Adds, edits or clears the caption (KennelPhotos.Description) on a kennel photo of any status. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 92). Gate: HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'editPhoto' on the photo's own kennel (resolved from the photo, so no @kennelId is sent) — Hash Flash / GM / VGM / RA and whoever else the data-driven matrix grants. NULL @description clears the caption; '' stores an empty caption.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: photoId
parameters.description: UUID of the photo to update. If no KennelPhotos row exists with this ID, a 'Photo not found' error is returned (errorCode 1333, errorType 13).

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: New caption text. NULL explicitly clears the existing caption. Empty string sets an empty caption (not the same as NULL). Defaults to NULL.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always present. Failure: success = 0 with ValidateAppAuth codes, 1333 / 13 photo not found, 1333 / 13 not authorised, or 1933 / 19 unhandled. Success: success = 1, errorCode / errorType NULL.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code. NULL on success.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification code. NULL on success.

rowsets.name: CaptionResult
rowsets.description: On success: the photo id and the caption now stored (NULL when cleared).

columns.name: description
columns.description: The new caption value. NULL if @description was passed as NULL (caption cleared).

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: On failure, in place of CaptionResult.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.KennelPhotos SET Description = @description, UpdatedAt = GETUTCDATE() WHERE id = @photoId (in a transaction).
Writes to HC.ErrorLog on photo-not-found, permission refusal, or unhandled error (CATCH rolls back first).

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken, @photoId (lines 3-5) have no SQL default. A client that omits one is refused by SQL before the procedure runs: no HC.ErrorLog row, an empty 500 in the app, and any graceful check inside is unreachable (CLAUDE.md, Rack of Lamb 2026-09-29).

codeSmells.issue: One error code for two different failures
codeSmells.detail: Lines 74 and 93 both return 1333 / errorType 13 — 'photo not found' and 'not authorised' cannot be told apart by code, only by title.
Line 68 looks the photo up by id only; a row with DeletedAt set still passes and has its caption changed.
Line 124 returns errorType 19 rather than the standard 5.

breakingChanges: New SP — no HC5 predecessor. No breaking changes from migration.
